decision_rule: The calibrated search band's top, in characters, must be at least 43. Below 43 is BAND_BELOW_FLOOR and halts before any held-out number is computed.
metric: Top of the calibrated search band, in characters.
notes: The floor of 43 characters guards against repeating an earlier band that suppressed the predicted periods. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
